title: Money watch
summary: Reads the Ledger for a charge made twice and a payment that repeats, and asks you once about each. A flag you say no to three times in a row switches itself off.
changes: The first version: Charged twice and Looks like it repeats, each with its own switch.
author: BrainDog

twice.label: Charged twice
twice.note: Asks when the same payee takes the same amount from the same account twice within two days.

repeats.label: Looks like it repeats
repeats.note: Offers to add a payee to Repeating after three payments about a month apart, within a tenth of each other.
